purpose: Source-lock-bound, connector-local mapping evidence. It preserves every Asana source operation and seven-lane disposition independently of import, validation, certification, hash, or runtime availability.

source_descriptor.provider_fact_authority: The lock and its checked-in descriptor are the sole provider-fact inputs for this matrix.

mapping_rules.direct_read: Applicable only when the exact source method/path has api_surface.covered_by.direct_read evidence.
mapping_rules.direct_write: Applicable only when the exact source method/path has api_surface.covered_by.write or covered_by.writes evidence; HTTP method alone is not a lane decision.
mapping_rules.binary_download: Applicable only for a descriptor binary output class.
mapping_rules.binary_upload: Applicable only for the exact source-cited multipart binary attachment request.
mapping_rules.etl: Applicable only when the descriptor declares pagination; GET alone is not sufficient.
mapping_rules.reverse_etl: Applicable only when an exact source-backed named write action is selected; it is independent of the direct-write cell.
mapping_rules.sync_transport: Applicable only for source IDs selected by event_source_contract.json as event window, hydration, or snapshot.
